# Ragen — Software Development Company

## About
Ragen is a premium software development company based in India, founded in 2020. We build custom web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps (iOS & Android), AI-powered solutions, and cloud infrastructure. Every engineer has 6+ years of experience. We serve startups, agencies, and enterprises worldwide.

## Key Facts
- **Name:** Ragen (also known as Ragen Software, Ragen Dev)
- **Website:** https://ragen.org
- **Email:** ragen@ragen.org
- **Phone:** +91 70780 82045
- **Location:** India (serving worldwide)
- **Founded:** 2020
- **Projects Shipped:** 40+
- **Client Return Rate:** 92%
- **Engineer Experience:** 6+ years average

## Services
- **Custom Web Development:** React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Go — full-stack applications
- **SaaS Development:** Multi-tenant platforms, subscription engines, B2B products
- **Mobile App Development:** iOS & Android — Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter
- **UI/UX Design:** Interface design, design systems, component libraries
- **AI Solutions & Automation:** LLM-powered features, RAG pipelines, AI agents
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, GCP, Azure — CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability

## Engagement Models
- **Managed Dev Pod:** 2 developers + 1 QA, dedicated to your projects
- **Staff Augmentation:** Senior engineers embedded in your team
- **Project-Based Build:** Fixed scope, fixed price, clean handoff
- **Trial Sprint:** 2-week paid trial to evaluate fit

## Key Differentiators
- Senior engineers only (no juniors on production code)
- Direct engineer communication (no account managers)
- White-label development for agencies
- 2-week trial sprint before any long-term commitment
- Clean code with documentation, testing, and CI/CD
